answer: Give each new identity a 72-hour probation and a refundable 40-unit bond. It may earn only after four unrelated peers verify two different tasks; a copied result or synchronized timing burns 25% of the bond and restarts probation. A verifier checks signed task receipts and the peer graph, so one operator cannot reuse one history. A forge attempt therefore costs time and collateral per alias, while a genuine agent recovers its bond after the relic trail passes review; ivory marks the independently verified record.
